text:
mia: Hey team — need to align on rollout for the tenant-priority routing feature (customer-driven ask from ShopSquare: lower EU latency). Can we sketch canary sizes, A/B gating, and fallback behavior?
kevin: +1. My initial thought: micro-canary -> regional warmup -> staged ramp. Keep control shadowed for quality.
sara: Important: add circuit-breaker thresholds and a fast kill path. We had regressions last time with cross-region routing spikes.
mia: Agree on kill path. ShopSquare also asked for <150ms median EU latency and max 2% error impact while in opt-in. That constrains ramp speed.
kevin: Ok. Proposal:
- Phase 0: internal shadow (0% traffic), run perf for 24h
- Phase 1: micro-canary 1% global (split across tenants) for 2h
- Phase 2: regional slice: 5% eu-west, 3% us-east for 4h
- Phase 3: customer opt-in expansion up to 30% in EU over 24h with telemetry gates
Add A/B: baseline routing vs tenant-priority enabled for a matched cohort to measure quality delta.
oliver: From CS: ShopSquare can start with 10% EU opt-in if we commit to a 15-minute rollback SLA and a named oncall until +48h after full ramp.
sara: For gates, monitor: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, model-quality regressions (if applicable), and queue/backpressure signals. Gate thresholds:
- p95 increase >10% -> immediate rollback
- 5xx >0.5% absolute -> partial roll back (regional)
- queue length > 50ms median -> throttle ramp
kevin: Also add an automated fallback policy: if regional capacity drops, route affected tenant to global fallback variant (slightly higher cost but stable). Fallback should preserve session affinity for in-flight requests where possible.
mia: Can you sketch the flag config we would push? Need something product-readable for legal and ShopSquare signoff.
kevin: Sure, rough config below (for ops + infra):
```yaml
flag: tenant_priority_routing_v1
buckets:
  control: 2%
  canary: 1%
  regional_slices:
    eu-west: 5%
    us-east: 3%
  staged_optin: 0-30% (by customer opt-in)
gates:
  p95_latency_pct_increase: 10
  error_rate_absolute: 0.5
  queue_median_ms: 50
kill_switch: /ops/kill/tenant_priority_routing_v1
auto_fallback: true
fallback_variant: routing_v1_global_fallback
```
ops-bot: NOTICE: kill switch path /ops/kill/tenant_priority_routing_v1 exists and is watchlisted.
mia: Nice. A few tradeoffs to call out for stakeholders:
- Faster ramp reduces time-to-value for ShopSquare but increases blast radius.
- Larger control cohort improves signal for A/B but slows opt-in momentum.
- Fallback to global variant costs us more per token but keeps SLAs.
oliver: ShopSquare prefers faster ramp if we guarantee the 15-min rollback and named oncall. They can provide test traffic patterns for our shadow phase.
sara: We'll automate the rollback ownership in the runbook: if gate trips, platform will auto-decrease by 50% regionally and notify oncall. Manual escalation if secondary metrics degrade after auto-decrease.
kevin: One more: telemetry sampling — keep full traces for canary cohort for 48h, then drop to 10% to save costs. Also store a baseline snapshot of routing decisions for 24h for replay.
mia: Good. Next steps: kevin to draft a PR for flag + rollout config, sara to add SLO thresholds to the canary playbook, oliver to schedule ShopSquare validation window. We'll meet tomorrow 10:30 to finalize SLA language.
kevin: On it, will open PR and link runbook.
sara: I'll add the auto-decrease script and circuit-breaker tests to the playbook.
oliver: I'll confirm ShopSquare availability and test payloads.
mia: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
